issue.title: Unblock E2 (sase-1n6): green exercise legs, a current steward verdict, a published core pin, and an executing handover gate
issue.description: sase-1n6.10 can watch and prove the first steward release. A master rehearsal of release.yml is green end to end, including both wheel exercise legs. Master pins a complete published sase-core-rs whose tag contains its source revision. A failed core cut that a newer green cut superseded no longer stops the steward. One human approval turns on merge authority, leaves the pypi environment tag-only, and relaunches sase-1n6.10 with corrected instructions.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/unblock_e2_release_cutover.md requests this work

issue.title: release.yml finds the previous release in a throwaway venv and fails loudly on real errors
issue.description: resolver: release.yml's previous-release resolver moves into tools/exercise_release, dry-runs each candidate in a throwaway uv venv instead of the externally managed --system interpreter, shows uv's stderr, and stops on errors that are not resolution failures. The SC2012 dist counts in the build step are replaced too.

issue.title: A failed core cut stops counting as red once a newer cut succeeds
issue.description: cut-red: in sase-core, handle_no_train reports CoreCutRed only when the newest decisive completed cut is a typed failure. A later successful cut supersedes a stale red cut. Rust state tests and the steward state docs row are updated.

issue.title: Master pins the published core that contains its source revision
issue.description: core-pin: once a complete published sase-core-rs (expected 0.42.7) contains sase-core-revision.txt, ratchet master's exact pin and uv.lock to it. If that tag also carries the cut-red fix, move the revision pin to the tag commit so the steward builds the fixed policy.

payload.entry: LOCAL PROOF: exercise_release previous-version --candidate-version 0.18.2 ran against live PyPI with HOME relocated and UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR pinned, selected 0.18.1, and wrote previous_version=0.18.1. A dry-run forced through uv --system --python /usr/bin/python3.13 reproduced uv’s externally managed refusal; resolver tests confirm interpreter, external-management, and network/index errors stop with ::error:: and are not skipped. Focused tests: 50 passed. actionlint .github/workflows/release.yml and git diff --check passed. sase tool run check b866ef7cd3ce609c6f45a7ca8cb18ea8 passed (exit 0; scoped tests 15m 41s). Full run-leg N-1 path not run: this checkout is version 0.18.1 and contains no candidate 0.18.2 dist artifact.

Implemented the previous-version resolver in tools/exercise_release using a throwaway managed-Python venv, explicit failure classification, and GitHub output; replaced SC2012 dist counts. Live PyPI proof selected 0.18.1 for 0.18.2; focused tests (50), actionlint, diff check, and sase tool run check b866ef7cd3ce609c6f45a7ca8cb18ea8 passed. Epic-symbol audit was empty.

LOCAL PROOF: previous-version live against PyPI for candidate 0.18.2 selected 0.18.1 with stdout exactly previous_version=0.18.1. Forced externally-managed failure (fake uv shim) exits 3 with ::error::UV_RESOLVE_FAILED naming externally-managed-environment. Focused tests: tests/test_exercise_release.py + tests/test_github_actions_release.py, 52 passed. actionlint clean, git diff --check clean, sase tool run check ec071904e2538c912805981ac962e6dc passed. Full run-leg N-1 path not run: this checkout is version 0.18.1 with no candidate 0.18.2 dist artifact.

Resolver moved into tools/exercise_release previous-version (throwaway uv venv, no --system; resolution failures skip with stderr tail, all other failures stop with ::error::). release.yml prev step calls the subcommand and appends previous_version to GITHUB_OUTPUT; UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR pinned pre-relocation so uv reuses the managed 3.12; SC2012 dist counts replaced with nullglob arrays.
